comments.text:
Ryan 2026-09-03: add a how-to row for compaction epochs. Do not draft yet.

Haiku explores and describes what it found. `/compact` before swapping up. Do not pass a large Haiku session to Opus — a model change invalidates the cache prefix. Opus writes the plan. `/compact` again. Sonnet does the work. Always compact history before changing models.

Related to ef4df5 (cache cost) but this is a click-path, not that article. Attach the recent harness writeups that use the phrase "compaction epochs." Do not invent titles.
